Who we are:

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer Intern to join our Game Development team. You'll work with senior developers on our internal game development tools and libraries, and contribute to the efficiency of our game production pipeline. This is hands-on engineering work with real ownership, and we expect a high standard from day one.

What You'll Do

• Develop and improve internal libraries together with other teams.
• Implement scoped tasks end to end, from understanding the problem to delivering a reviewed, tested solution.
• Write short technical design documents before implementing, to guide your own work.
• Profile, debug and optimize on real iOS and Android devices.
• Work on third-party integrations and platform-specific functionality.
• Improve technical documentation and training resources.
• Work with people from different teams and areas, and keep them informed of progress and blockers.
• Take part in code reviews, giving and receiving direct feedback.

What You Bring

• Strong C# and programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
• Proficiency in Unity3D, demonstrated by at least one complete project we can see (published, or a repository we can read).
• Working knowledge of computer math (vectors, matrices, quaternions) and 2D/3D graphics.
• Effective debugging: you find root causes rather than patching symptoms.
• Disciplined coding habits and awareness of industry best practices.
• Very good interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to collaborate inside a group of senior developers.

Bonus

• Having built and run your own app or game on iOS and/or Android devices.
• Experience with performance analysis tools (Unity Profiler, Xcode Instruments, Android Studio Profiler).
• Experience integrating a third-party SDK.
• Knowledge of Swift/Objective-C or Kotlin/Java.

What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?

• Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
• A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
• Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
• Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam

Onsite perks include:

• State of the art gym facilities
• Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
• Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)

The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Please contact us at recruitment@socialpoint.es to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.

Please be aware that Socialpoint does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Socialpoint’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a zynga.com, take2games.com, naturalmotion.com, smallgiantgames.com, themavens.com, gram.gs email domain).
